title: Guy Ferrari
content: Last night, I dreamed of my mall world restaurant. Recently, I’ve been going to a two story restaurant, but the top floor is open to the bottom floor, so everyone on the top floor, is eating at tables that overlook the ground floor. I was rejected from this restaurant last night because I only had just me in my party. I was kicked out, then went to the lobby to tell them they were being unfair, when guy Ferrari was meeting people in the lobby. There was also a hot body guard that was gonna let me in, but that’s not important lol
